headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Creating engaging digital and print visual content with a strong foundation in branding and visual communication.

skills.label: Design Tools
skills.items: Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, Framer, Webflow

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Branding, Visual Identity, Typography, Layout, Print Production, Social/Marketing Creative, Design Systems

skills.label: Workflows
skills.items: AI-assisted design (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly), Wireframing, Prototyping, Usability Testing

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Managed print-ready files focusing on bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy, applying typography, colour systems, and layout principles.
Collaborated with HR and management stakeholders to achieve low revision cycles.
Utilized AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Produced product visuals and marketing assets using Photoshop and Illustrator.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
Conducted usability testing and fed findings back into user flows and interface usability.

projects.name: Fashion Brand Social Campaign
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that resulted in a 15% increase in follower engagement.

projects.name: AT Creation Startup Branding Kit
bullets: Developed comprehensive logo, typography, and color palette guidelines.
